rules.statement: Appellants must show they have suffered damage by irregular partition proceedings to set them aside.
rules.supporting_quote: "It may be that Manuel Fernando intended to conserve his children's interest by giving them half, or perhaps even the whole, of the parcel to be allotted to him in severalty, or he may have intended in some other way to compensate them, and he may in fact have carried out this intention. Certainly the appellants are now the owners of that entire parcel, as they are the heirs of their father and they are in possession."
